purpose: Sentiment and themes of customer reviews, shown as a summary. Advisory only.
method: TF-IDF word (1-2) + character (3-5) n-grams; multinomial logistic regression (sentiment); one-vs-rest logistic regression (themes).
data: data/reviews.psv - 110 student-authored review concepts x 3 languages (see data/PROVENANCE.md).
test_set_note: The test reviews were scored once before class balancing was added (themes then lost to the keyword lexicon). Balancing was chosen by grouped cross-validation only, but the test set is no longer strictly unseen. The themes margin over the lexicon is small on 23 concepts: treat the two as roughly equal.
limits: Small synthetic dataset; Setswana and Afrikaans unreviewed. Sarcasm and mixed reviews are hard. Never used to hide, rank or remove reviews.
